description: Byte ranges of pinned public checkpoints that this repository reads. Whole checkpoints are never downloaded: tools/fetch-fixtures.py fetches each range with an HTTP range request and checks its length and sha256.
cache: build/fixtures/{repo with '/' replaced by '--'}/{revision}/{file}/{begin}-{end}.bin; the prefix ranges of a file are stored concatenated as prefix.bin in the same directory

conventions.begin_end: byte offsets in the file, end exclusive

kind.prefix: the first bytes of the file, in chunks 0-1 MiB, 1-2 MiB, 2-4 MiB, 4-8 MiB and 8-16 MiB, up to the end of the container header
kind.header: a container header read on its own
kind.tensor: tensor data: the whole tensor, or with tensor_offset a slice of it
kind.scale: quantization parameters stored apart from the trits: packed weight_scale, MLX scales and biases (the f32 scale of an I2_S tensor is the first 4 bytes of its trailer range)
kind.trailer: the 32 bytes after the packed trits of an I2_S tensor: the f32 scale, then 28 bytes the dequantizer does not read

conventions.tensor_offset: offset of begin inside the tensor data, when the range is not the whole tensor
conventions.shape: safetensors: the header shape (row-major); GGUF: ne order, ne[0] (contiguous) first
conventions.ggml_type: the GGUF tensor type id as stored in the file; layout names the storage layout that id denotes in the runtime the file was made for
conventions.lfs_sha256: the Hub's sha256 of the whole file, for provenance; never downloaded or checked here

consumers.bitnet_audit: python3 tools/bitnet_audit.py (reports/ternary-check/bitnet-audit-2026-09-23.json); its scales.rows also reproduce the 210 i2s_f32 and hf_packed_bf16 values of reports/ternary-check/bitnet-scales-2026-09-22.json, whose f32 scale words are the first 4 bytes of the I2_S trailer ranges
consumers.layer0_matvec: layer-0 int8-activation matvec on decoded weights (#33)
